report.answer: Core SSE streaming lives in src/core/streaming.ts (class Stream, plus _iterSSEMessages/SSEDecoder), re-exported via src/streaming.ts; the client's request layer (src/client.ts, buildRequest/fetch handling around line 1000-1130) decides to return a Stream when `stream: true` is set.
